claim: Full deterministic fallback is order-equivalent when the ranked order is a permutation of the exact finite candidate list. Checked early stop is safe only with a verifier-facing certificate that the checked winner dominates the checked prefix and the unchecked suffix, plus exact coverage of the full candidate list. A verifier-accepted candidate with the same volume and surplus as a certified representative is an objective-equivalent global weak optimum over the same exact finite family.

commands.command: cd lean-mathlib && lake env lean Proofs/UniformBatchOptimality.lean

limits: The Lean theorems are finite-candidate-family certificates. Synthetic corpus global completeness requires exact-audit-set premises.
The checked-stop benchmark values are offline audits over verified suffix labels. Online early stop still needs a deterministic suffix-bound certificate or full fallback.
Top-k recall is empirical accelerator evidence only.
Objective-equivalent winners require deterministic verifier acceptance and equality of the objective fields used by the certificate. The quotient over tied maxima leaves validity rules unchanged.
